description:
Your phone is going to get used anyway. Goomi makes those minutes count.

Pick the apps you open on autopilot. When you reach for one, Goomi steps in with a short challenge: a quick recall question, a surprising fact, a mini brain game. Finish it and you're back in the app. A few minutes later, another one. It never turns into another endless feed.

STUDY WITH YOUR OWN MATERIAL
• Add lecture notes, PDFs, slides or a photo of your notebook
• Goomi turns them into recall prompts and flashcards
• Weak concepts come back more often with spaced repetition

MODES FOR YOUR DAY
• Free: languages, geography, science, history, art and fun facts
• Study: active recall on your uploaded material, ready for exams
• Work: short resets that bring you back to the task at hand
• Sleep: calm, low-stimulation moments before bed

BUILT TO FEEL GOOD
• Goomi, a small lime companion who reacts to every answer
• Challenges with a clear ending, never an infinite scroll
• Streaks and progress you can actually see

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Goomi uses Apple's Screen Time API. Which apps you use, and how long, stays on your device.

GOOMI PLUS
Unlock every mode, many more study materials and all challenge types with a monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://goomi.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://goomi.app/privacy
promotionalText: Pick the apps that pull you in. Goomi turns each open into a quick challenge, so your screen time adds up to something.
